sloka: उत्पत्स्यते हि मद्वंशे पुरुषो राक्षसाधम ।यस्त्वां सपुत्रं सामात्यं सबलं साश्वसारथिम् ।निहनिष्यति सङ्ग्रामे त्वां कुलाधम दुर्मते ।। ६.६०.९ ।।।।
transliteration: utpatsyate hi madvaṁśe puruṣo rākṣasādhama ।yastvāṁ saputraṁ sāmātyaṁ sabalaṁ sāśvasārathim ।nihaniṣyati saṅgrāme tvāṁ kulādhama durmate ।। 6.60.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "I think that Dasaratha's son Rama, a human being is about whom king Anaranya born in Ikshvaku race, who cursed me earlier saying, 'In my race will be born a man who will kill you in war, with your sons, your horses, charioteers, all army, O evil minded lowest of Rakshasas, and the vilest of Rakshasas."
